Sometime before the [[Galactic War]], a '''Mandalorian clan''' fought against twenty [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. The battle turned in the Mandalorian clan's favor only after [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Raze (Sith)|Raze]] single-handedly engaged the Jedi in combat; though Raze would [[Death/Legends|fall]] during this event. Moved by [[Gender/Legends|her]] bravery and combat skills, the clan honored Raze's death with a ''[[kote ky'ram]]'', the first time such an honor was ever bestowed to an outsider.<ref name="Codex" />
